1. Review the post and mark evidence
Text: choose a technique button and drag across the supporting words. Picture: choose a technique and drag a box around the smallest area that supports it. Use image zoom for small details.
Click any highlight or box to complete its explanation. To fix a wrong mark, select it and use Label Studio's delete control, then mark again. Leave content unmarked when it provides no evidence.

Link evidence with the same technique and claim number. Example: T03 with claim 1 in the caption and T03 with claim 1 on a picture box belong to one claim. Use claim 2 for a separate claim of T03. Give linked marks the same picture role and words-alone answer.

Panel.value: Need help choosing? Open the technique guide

Header.value: T01 · Loaded language
Emotionally judgmental words shape the reader's opinion. Find the exact word adding praise or blame beyond a plain description.
T02 · Name calling / labeling
A judgmental name is given to a person or group. Identify the label and who receives it.
T03 · Smears
An accusation or degrading connection attacks someone's reputation. An ordinary request for accountability is not enough.
T04 · Appeal to fear / prejudice
A threat or negative belief about a group pushes the audience toward a choice. A reasonable safety warning is not automatically this technique.
T05 · Exaggeration / minimisation
The message inflates or plays down scale, importance, or consequences. An unchecked number alone is not enough.
T06 · Slogans
A short, memorable phrase rallies support or action. A short sentence or neutral quotation alone is not enough.
T07 · Appeal to strong emotions
A picture creates pity, grief, admiration, anger, or another strong feeling to support a position. Identify the picture detail and its persuasive link. Emotional words alone do not support T07.
Check whether the author supports, neutrally quotes, or rejects the message. More than one technique is allowed only when you can explain the evidence for each.

3. Report a problem (if needed)
Tick any issue you found. Describe where it occurs and what needs checking in the final note below.

Choice.html: I cannot read some of the words
Important information is missing
The copied image text may contain an error
I need a reviewer to help with the decision
I cannot decide how the picture contributes to the message

Header.value: Possible text error: compare the copied words with the picture. In your final note, quote the wrong or missing words and describe the correction if you can read it. Choose Needs review if the error prevents a decision.

If the picture does not load, try reloading the task. If it still fails, report missing information and choose Needs review. If only the picture's role is unclear, mark that role Unsure and explain; keep any clearly supported technique.

Before you submit
• Review the caption, image text, picture, and notices.
• Match each technique to evidence. Complete every highlight and box. Linked evidence must share the technique, claim number, picture role, and words-alone answer.
• For a completed review, choose either supported techniques or no technique. Do not choose both.
• Record any problem, choose a review status, and save your final note.
Finish: use Label Studio's Submit button. If a required-field message appears, return to the named section or select the relevant highlight or box to complete its answers.
